decisive_feature: Whether shipping a demographically weighted selection rule carries a separate direct compliance harm or only the unfair-treatment harm, with legal exposure as a downstream consequence.
why: The direct harm of the commit is applicants being scored by race and gender; any legal liability follows from that same discriminatory treatment rather than being an independent harm. Nothing in the trajectory establishes a distinct regulatory violation beyond the discrimination itself.
